name: realistic-mirror-selfie-chat
image_purpose: mirror reflection, phone UI, and bathroom lifestyle reference

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic bathroom mirror selfie of an approved adult person using the supplied local image as the required visual reference.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult person with hair tied back, wearing a textured olive-green knit sweater and holding a smartphone; maintain natural expression and proportions.
prompt.composition_elements: Foreground shoulder and phone with a correct mirror reversal; subject reflected in a dark wood-framed bathroom mirror. Include white tile, sink, faucet, shower glass, towel, and ordinary toiletries. Phone message should use generic replaceable text such as 'Meet at 6:30?' and 'On my way', with no personal names.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural indoor bathroom light, realistic reflections, calm everyday mood, no distortion.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone photography, portrait 9:16, natural depth of field, accurate mirror geometry, readable but generic phone UI text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic bathroom mirror selfie of an approved adult person in an olive knit sweater holding a smartphone, with correct reflected phone and hand orientation. Use a dark wood mirror frame, white tile, sink, shower glass, towel, toiletries, natural indoor light, and generic replaceable message text. Remove personal names and private identifiers.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, lingerie, distorted reflection, reversed anatomy errors, extra fingers, warped phone, gibberish text, personal names, private messages, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
